## History

Tillie Boulter is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school under the instruction of Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). She attends school alongside other local children, including [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md).

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--tillie-boulter.md)

Tillie Boulter is a friend and schoolmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their relationship consists of typical classroom camaraderie, which includes sharing gossip and borrowing jewelry from one another.

- Friend of — schoolmates who share jewelry and gossip  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>
